tei:div.tei:p: 529) ༄༅/ rat+na'i thugs rje gsang 'dus kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor khyer bder bkod pa yid ches gsum ldan bya ba zhugs/ 530)

bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir khyab bdag bla ma kun bzang shes rab kyi phyag bzhes bzhin sgrub dbang skur ba la/ hrīḥ sngon bskal dang*/ spos phyung / ji snyed su dag zin nas/ 'dir rang gzhung las ma sgrub sangs rgyas thob thabs lnga: sngon sbyangs las sad rtogs grol dang: rang byung rgyud mchog btags grol dang: mtshan ldan pad can rtsa yi gnad: gsang lam zab mo 'pho ba dang: ngo mtshar rdzas mchog skye bdun no: zhes snga 'gyur ba'i khyad chos ma bsgoms sangs rgyas chos lnga'i ya gyal ngo mtshar rdzas mchog skye bdun sgrub pa'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu la/ sbyor ba gnas bya ba/ rdzas brtag pa/ ril bu sbyor ba/ dngos 531) gzhi ji ltar sgrub pa'i rim pa la/ spyi yi sbyor ba/ sgos kyi sbyor ba/ sgrub byed dmigs pa'i rim pa rnams tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i sgo nas legs par grub nas/ spyi don gsum pa mjug tu dbang skur ba la/ ji skad du/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen yin te// 'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas// zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rdo rje theg pa dag snang gi lam sa yin pas gnas yul thams cad lho phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin gyi zhing khams kyi bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su khyed rang rnams snying rje'i dbang phyug gsang ba 'dus pa'i sku 'di ltar du sgoms shig dmigs med stong pa'i sogs nas/ dag tu sgoms/ /bar dang*/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du slob bu'i 532) snying gi dbus su sogs nas rā ga'i gtor dbang ltar/ thim par sgoms shig sgrub khog byin 'bebs las byang lha gsum bstod pa/ thugs dam gnad skul/ smre bshags bcas/ hūm̐/ dri med dag par khrus snying sngon bgegs gtor las byang skrad srung*/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun bcas zin nas sems bskyed gsal/ de'ang dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gsang gsum yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid chen po o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid kyis gdul bya gzhan snang tsam du/

o rgyan yul gyi shar phyogs rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub bkra shis brag phug mā ra ti kar 'chi med tshe la dbang ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa bsgrubs gnas grub pa brnyes pa'i skabs su gnas mchog ri bo tā lar 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po dngaus las spyan ras gzigs 'khor ba dong sprug rgyal ba rgya mtsho gsang ba 'dus pa/ yang snying 'dus pa/ yid bzhin go mchog phyag stong spyan stong la sogs pa'i rgyud mchog brgya dang rtsa brgyad zhus shing yongs su rdzogs pa'i bka' babs thob pa la brten nas sgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa mtha' 533) yas par mdzad/ bod yul 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi 'dul zhing khyad par du gyur pa la dgongs nas skal ldan rje 'bangs pho mo rnams thugs rje chen po'i rgyud dang man ngag gi rim pa mtha' yas pa bstsal ba rnams kyi nang nas phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba ma lus pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i gdams skor 'di nyid pad+ma gsung gi bka' babs rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la lang gro lo tsā ba dkon mchog 'byung gnas sogs la khyad par du bstsal cing phyi rabs gdul bya'i don du sba bar gdams pa ltar/ gsang ba'i bdag mo mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis lho brag gnam skas can du dam chos 'dus pa skor bzhi lhan cig tu sba bar mdzad pa/ phyis 'don ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ mnga' bdag nyang gi gter lung las/ lo ni lnga bcu kha ral dus: nyi ma shar lho'i phyogs dag tu: chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling: phrin las bzhi la mnga' brnyes pa: mtsho rgyal khyod kyi sprul pa'am: byin gyis brlabs pa'i skyes bu 'byung: zhes dang*/ chos dbang 534) gi sku gsum sgrub pa'i lung byang las 'di nas byang phyogs shing sgo'i mtshams: ri bo khyung chen lta bu'i sar: lug lo pad+ma dbang chen rtsal: bskyed rdzogs don la mkhas pa 'byung: zhes dang*/ rin chen gling pa'i gter kha spyi 'dus 'khor lo'i las byang las/

rigs ldan gsung gi sprul pa ni: gangs ri'i bskor ba'i sa phyogs su: skyes bu blo gros stobs ldan pa: rat+na gling zhes grags pa 'byung: zhes dang*/ shes rab me 'bar gter lung las/ gter gyi bstan skyong 'gro 'dul gling: mon bod gnyis kyi mtshams su 'byung: zhes dang*/ gu ru jo tse'i gter lus las/ mon bu spyi ring skra yi lwa ba can: ri bo khyung chen ldang ba'i zhol du 'byung: zhes dang gu ru tshe brtan gter lung las/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul ba: gnas lugs don gyi dgongs gter rdol: chos kyi bstan 'dzin rat+na gling: zhes dang*/ o rgyan gling pa'i pad+ma bka' thang las/ khyung chen brag la sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: de dus ri bo khyung chen lding ba'i skor: 535) lcags khams lug lo pad+ma'i rigs can 'byung: khyung chen ri dang mkhar chu'i zab gter 'don: gsang ba'i mtshan yang zhig po gling par grags: gung thang dge yi rdzong gsum gter kha 'don: gsang ba'i mtshan yang rat+na gling par grags: bsam yas gnam skas bum thang gter kha 'don: gsang ba'i mtshan yang 'gro 'dul gling par grags: stobs ldan skyes bu shes rab blo gros can: don gyi rtogs ldan gdul bya'i bka' babs pa: 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma'i rigs can te: bu mchog de yis gnyis ka spyod par 'gyur: zhes sogs rdo rje lung gi dpang por gyur pa'i lang gro lo tsā ba'i yang srid sprul pa'i gter chen rat+na gling pas gnam skas can nas spyan drangs te bum sgrub chen mo sum cu so lnga re re bzhin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kun gyis mthun grub dang bcas pa btsugs nas myong grol sbyin pas bod yul mtha' dbus kun la khyab par mdzad/ de nas bzung rang gter las/ de'i brgyud 'dzin las can chos kyi bdag: bka' 536) babs bu lnga nye ba'i thugs sras bzhi: rigs ldan lnga dang dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa brgyad: las can skyes bu chos bdag nyi shu lnga:

dbang rdzogs chos 'brel ser mo khri phrag lnga: 'brel nas gdul bya nam mkha'i skar ma tsam: zhes gsungs ba'i rtsa ba'i chos bdag lung gis bstan pa rim dang gcig char du byung ba rnams dang*/ ma gcig mtsho rgyal gyis/ ma 'ongs gter la mos pa'i gang zag rnams: deng sang gu ru'i zhal mthong smon lam btab: thams cad las can yin pas dga' ba sgoms: kho mo'i tshig 'di rin chen gser bas dkon: zhes dang*/ lung bstan bka' rgya mar/ mdor na o rgyan ngas bstan chos rnams la: gzhung bzhin su dang su yi spyod pa kun: thams cad nga yi sprul pa yin par nges: phyi rabs kun gyi yid gnyis the tshom spangs: gus pas bkur sti phu dud 'brel pa thogs: zhes dang*/ rang gter lang gro'i zhus len las/ skal ldan de yi gdul bya 537) rjes 'jug rnams: slob ma bas kyang yang slob rjes slob dus: rim pa bzhin du bstan pa mtha' rgyas gyur: phyogs mtshams mtha' dbus kun tu chos 'di dar: snyigs ma'i 'gro ba phyam gcig thar lam bgrod: phrad mchog mthong grol gyur te ngo mtshar che: zhes rdo rje'i lung gis zin pa'i snga 'gyur rig 'dzin grub pa brnyes pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas da lta'i bar du mdo khams stod smad kun tu thugs gsang gi bstan pa dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel rgyas rgyun ma chad pa byung ba'i zab chos yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid kyi skyes bdun bum sgrub chen mo'i sgrub dbang bskur thabs rgyas par sgrub pa'i thog mar/ mtshams sbyor spyi mthun gyi mig dar me tog gtad/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor bdag po dbyer ma mchis pa la gus pa chen pos gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kyai/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor/ dbang chog ltar lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba gdab pa la snod kyi skal ba brtag cing dri ba 'dri ba yin te/ bu rnams= de'i lan gsol bar mos pas 538) 'di'i rjes zlos/ bdag cag skal ldan= zhes gsol bas snod dang ldan par rig nas gnang ba sbyin pa ni/

gsang 'dus thugs rje'i= de la thog mar sdom pa dam tshig mtha' dag gi gzhi rten skyabs su 'gro dgos pas bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha phyogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la bdag gzhan mkha' khyab gyi sems can thams cad dong nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma yi dam= skyabs gsol dang sdig pa bshags pas rgyud sbyong ba sngon du 'gro ba can gyi so sor thar pa'i sdom pa smon 'jug byang sems kyis bslab pa sogs tshul bzhin du blang zhing don dam byang chub mchog tu sems skyed pa rnams gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la= maṇ+ḍal 'dir ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis pa gsal ba la khyed rang rnams la sngar byin pa'i me tog de nyid rang rang gi lha gang yin pa la phog par shog cig snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag pos 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas te 'dor bar zhu/ ho sku gsung thugs ky-i sgrub khog ltar la khyed rnams kyi me tog phog pa'i 539) lha dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po gsang ba 'dus par zungs la gsang ba'i mtshan yang rigs 'dus thugs rje'i dbang phyug ces bya ba yin no// mig dbye ba'i don du las kyi slob dpon gyis zhu ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ ho las dang= khyed rang rnams kyi lhan skyes ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yog mig dar dang lhan cig gsal bar mos shig nga ni thar pa'i= de ltar dri med ye shes kyi spyan thob pas rang snang rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po mngon sum du mthong bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas sgrib pa sbyong ba'i slad du slob ma rnams gsang 'dus sogs/ kun bzang shes rab kyi zin bris ltar/ su pra tiṣ+tha badz+ra ye swā ha/ bar nar 'gro/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams yin/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la thog mar bum pa'i dbang nyid la'ang phyi nang gsang ba rtsal dbang rnams su yod pa las dang po phyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/

slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'phros/ dal gyis lha tshogs rnams la phog pas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 540) dang rgyal ba rigs lngas dbang gi dgongs pa mdzod/ rigs kyi yum lngas dbang skur/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis pa'i las mdzad/ thub pa rigs drug dang bskal bcang gi sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis kyis smon lam chen pos rgyas gdab cing bden tshig gi shis pa rjod/ rtsal chen khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing srung ba'i las mdzad bum pa spyi bor bzhag pa'i tshe bum nang gi lha tshogs thams cad kyi las bdud rtsir babs/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshangs bug nas zhugs lus thams cad gang*/ rnam shes kyis bsdus pa'i sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad bkrus/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje dngos su gyur pa yin snyam pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod cig hūm̐/ bum pa spros bral= dbang dang zin bris 'brel mas bum dbang rdzogs mthar las byang bkra shis rjod/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan snying pos mtshan pa'i prog zhu dbu la gsol bas phung khams lnga sku dang ye shes lngar gnas gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas sku lnga= zhi ba'i chas brgyad kyis 541) mnga' gsol longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i yon tan la mnga' dbang thob par mos shig hūm̐/ mi brjod= rigs lnga yab yum kyi phyag mtshan rnams kyis dbang bskur bas rgyal po rgyal srid thob pa ltar ye shes dpag tu med pa'i 'byor pa la dbang bar mos shig hūm̐/ rdo rje rtse lngas= dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las ye shes kyi sku gnyis 'phros nas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas so sor thim pas gnyis su med par byin brlabs par mos/ hūm̐ rdo rje sems dpa'-i= sogs nas lha dbang rdzogs nas / de ltar phyi dbang rdzogs par thob pas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal pos rin chen sna bdun gyi 'byor pa thob pa ltar gsang chen chos kyi rgyal srid chen po la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i nus pa rgyud la bzhags yin no// gnyis pa nang dbang skur ba la khyed rang rnams gsang 'dus rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku 'di ltar gsal thob cig

dmigs med stong pa'i= dag tu sgoms= bar dang sgrub yig hūm̐/ sku ni= gsum pa gsang ba'i dbang ni shel dang me long gis mtshon nas rang rig chos sku ngo bo dri med rnam dag 542) rang rtsal sna tshogs su 'char ba'i rang ngo ma bcos bslad med par sa ler zhog cig hūm̐/ rang byung= bzhi pa rig rtsal gyi dbang skur ba la khyed rang rnams thal mo sbyor la gsang ba 'dus pa'i skyed rim 'di ltar gsal thobs/ dmigs med stong pa'i= dag tu sgom= snying gar zla steng= kyai ho nyon cig= de nas snyen sgrub chen mo dang 'brel ba'i sgrub dbang sbyin pa la sku rten spyi bor bzhag pas sku dbang ma lus pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ bde shegs ma lus= sgrub khog ltar/ yig drug gi sngags byang mgrin par bzhag pas gsung dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spros med mtha' bral rma bya'i sgro mdongs lte bar bzhag pas gsang gsum yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ma lus sku gsung thugs= gter dbang 'dir sbyar na byin 'bebs yan bskur nas 'phros gtang*/ ma sbyar na yang mi dgos/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya gnas gsum du bzhag cing dbang bskur bas phyag mtshan 543) yig 'bru gsum duthim sgo gsum tha mal du 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang ba gsum gyi phyag rgyas thebs par mos shig oṃ sku ni mi 'gyur= hūm̐ bde shegs rgyal ba= dmigs med stong pa'i= hūm̐ dbang bskur byin brlabs= kun gsal gyi tshogs byin rlabs/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin= hūm̐ bza' dang= dral bab byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas mchog brgyad kyis dbang bskur zhing mnga' gsol bas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bkra shis bde legs kyi dpal yon ji snyed pa thams cad bde blag tu thob par mos shig hūm̐/ yungs dkar= tshe 'brang=

mgon po tshe dpag med par gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe chad nyams yar ba thams cad dang 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i tshe bsod dpal yon dwangs bcud ma lus pa bsdus nas phyag gi bum par zhugs bum pa'i bdud rtsid chil chil khol te kha nas lud/ khyed rang rnams kyi 544) spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang ltem gyis gang skye 'chi med pa'i rdo rje'i sku thob pa'i nges shes skyed cig hūm̐/ gsang 'dus thugs rjes= des dus ma yin par 'chi ba zlog cing tshe mthar phyin par gyur pa yin no/ de nas ril bu'i bum dbang gi slad du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kyai/ bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag: thugs rje chen po skyabs kyi mchog: bum dbang bdag la skur du gsol:

lan gsum/ bum pa 'di nyid ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang rgyan dang bkod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du ril bu re re bzhin thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa yab yum rigs bdag ye shes sems dpa' dang bcas par gsal ba'i gnas bzhi nas ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung khyed rang rnams kyi gnas bzhir thim pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag cing*/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i dbang thob rnam bzhi dang dbyer med du byin gyi brlabs pas 545) mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gdod ma'i grol sar 'bad med du grol ba'i nus stobs rdzogs par mos shig hūm̐/ rang byung thugs rje= skye bdun sgrub gzhung ltar/ ril bu spyan ras gzigs dngos su gsal ba las khyed rang rnams lha dam tshig par gsal ba'i zhal gyi sgo nas byon/snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi ze'u 'brur ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de lta bu'i phan yon yang*/ ril bu su yi ltor= bsam yas ltar= rgya chen spyod: zhes pas mtshon rgyud lung kun nas bsngags pa tshad med pa 'byung ba ltar lags so/ /de tsam mi spro na rig 'dzin chen pos mdzad pa'i dkar chag dang spyod tshul le tshan rnams gtang*/ gter gzhung gsang sgrub lta bur khrid btab nas/ legs 'ong rigs kyi= sogs nas / 'bral mi srid: ces gdams par mdzad pa nyid rtag tu mi bsnyel bar thugs la 'jags par mdzod/ mtshams sbyor bcas bkra shis rjod/ de ltar na de dag rnams kyi chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling pa'i zab gter dam chos 546) 'dus pa skor bzhi'i ya gyal thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i ngo mtshar rdzas mchog skye bdun myong grol chen mo'i sgrub dbang legs par grub pa yin no/ sogs rjod/ dam tshig khas blang gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus dbul/ dge bsngo rnams spyi ltar bya'o/
